summary: Analyzes heterogeneous firing rate profiles in macaque PMd neurons by applying CP tensor decomposition to trial-averaged data sorted by choice and stimulus difficulty.
use_when: How do single neurons in the macaque PMd exhibit diverse firing rate profiles during decision tasks?
Perform tensor decomposition on PMd electrophysiological data to extract ramping vs non-monotonic activity.
Analyze Cisek and Kalaska PMd neuronal heterogeneity using CP decomposition
Identify temporal dynamics of PMd neurons sorted by choice and stimulus coherence
How does PMd activity challenge the uniform accumulator model of decision-making?
avoid_when: Neural and behavioral measurements cannot be aligned on a common time base
A low-dimensional embedding alone would be treated as confirmatory statistical evidence
